description: Books `start`, which must be one of the `slots` from get_available_slots. Free events are confirmed at once, unless the event type has `requiresApproval`: then it's a request (status=pending_approval) that holds the time until a host approves or declines it, and the invitee hears either way by email. Nobody answering by its start (`holdExpiresAt`) lets it lapse. Tell the human it isn't confirmed yet. Paid events return status=pending_payment and a `paymentUrl`. Give it to the human to pay before `holdExpiresAt`, or the slot is released. Once confirmed, the event is added to the host's calendar if they connected one, and the invitee gets a confirmation email with a calendar file (.ics). Keep `manageUrl` and `token`: they are the only way to view, reschedule or cancel later. 409 slot_unavailable says why the time can't be booked and lists the `nearest` open times. The result's `when` is the start in the invitee's time zone, to tell them. For a video call, `meetingUrlStatus` says where the link stands: `ready` (in `meetingUrl`), `pending` (the host's calendar is making it: call get_booking with the `manageUrl` in a few seconds, and tell the person the link is on its way and in their email), `on_confirmation`, `host_sends` or `none`. `videoService` names the service (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) even before the link is there.

answers.description: answers to the event type's `questions` (get_public_profile), as [{ id, value }]. Every question with `required` true needs one, or the booking is refused (422 answers_required, which lists them): ask the person for what you don't know. The others can come now or later with answer_booking

id.description: the question's `id`, from `questions` on get_public_profile or on the booking
id.title: maxLength(24)

value.description: the answer: words for a text question, one of its `options` for a choice, a phone number with its country code for a phone question
value.title: maxLength(500)

answers.title: maxItems(8)

cover.description: leave it out: the id of the painting the booking page showed, when the event type shows a different one each booking (cover "hand", "light" or "still"), so the booking keeps it. Anything else is ignored, and Tempi picks one
cover.title: maxLength(40)

email.description: the invitee's email address, which gets the confirmation and its calendar file

handle.description: a handle, the first part of a booking link ("acme" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

notes.description: anything the invitee wants the host to know
notes.title: maxLength(2000)

phone.description: the invitee's phone number with its country code, like +1 415 555 0134: required when the event type is a phone call (whereKind phone on get_public_profile), where the host calls them
phone.title: maxLength(40)

repeat.description: book a series instead: `count` meetings, `every` 1, 2 or 4 weeks at the host's clock time, when the event type's repeatMax allows. All or nothing: check_series first. The result's `series.meetings` give each start as `when` in the invitee's time zone, and `series.clockNote` says when that moves

count.description: how many meetings, first included (2 up to the event type's repeatMax)
count.title: between(2, 52)

slug.description: an event type slug from get_public_profile ("demo" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

start.description: one of the `slots` values from get_available_slots, as given (ISO in UTC)

timezone.description: the invitee's time zone, an IANA id like America/New_York or an abbreviation like EST: their emails and reminders show times in it

name: create_booking
title: Book a meeting
